name: Amagami Kanna
source:
Live in Amanomori shrine, Kanna is the main heroine of Oni Kagura and eldest daughter of the Amagami sister.
Kanna is a serious bullish, short-tempered and overconfident. However she is actually a kind, loyal, and respectful person. She is very easy to anger when considering Kijima's behavior and often argues with him like cat and dog.
Kanna is skilled in Shizugokoro-ryu sword technique. There is no hesitation in her when she kills her opponent, an ayakashi-killer professional.

Kanna's weapon of choice is a long sword nodachi. 
CV: Misumi- みすみ
